Loop over each tracked account slug (piraeus-bank, viva, mellongroup, withplum, natech, printec, snappibank, aegean-baltic-bank, cardlink-sa, manpowergroup-greece-1, epay, ...). Parse results[] for job title/location/department/date. Detail/apply URL per job = https://apply.workable.com/{account-slug}/j/{shortcode}/. Poll periodically for A5 early-intent hiring signals.

For bulletins/activity data use /buletine-statistikore/, /buletine-informuese/, /raporti-i-aktivitetit/, /raporti-buxhetit/ and the Open Data page /te-dhena-te-hapura/. English mirror at /en/homepage/.

download.type: PDF (announcements); ESG factsheet available as XLSX

sources.recommended_method: Scrape the static HTML announcements list at /about-us/investor-relations/stoixeia-metoxis/stoixeia-metoxis-anakoinoseis/ (chronological, non-paginated, no auth) to harvest PDF links under /media/<slug>/*.pdf; GET each PDF directly (no auth, supports range requests). Same pattern for financial results and newsroom pages. GR and EN mirrors exist via /en/ prefix.

download.type: XML (sitemap index; RSS at /rss is application/rss+xml, UTF-16)

sources.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered HTML section pages (no JS needed): /tenderi and /Tenderi/DodjeleUgovoraPretraga for A2 procurement (paginated), /registar/{id}/{slug} for A1/A6 company profiles (public financials 2010-2023, employees, ID/VAT), /kapital/bankarstvo for A1/A6 banking news. Poll the RSS feed https://www.akta.ba/rss (decode UTF-16) and crawl sub-sitemaps under https://www.akta.ba/sitemap.xml (sitemap-kapital.xml, sitemap-karijera.xml for A5, etc.) for incremental URL discovery. Respect robots.txt: avoid /tenderi?, /registar?, /pretraga, /registar-pretraga and *Preview endpoints; use canonical path URLs instead.

Static HTTP scraping. Crawl the listing pages (English: /eng/c/105/annual-report, /eng/c/8/news, /eng/c/102/career-opportunities; Albanian: /c/46/pasqyra-financiare, /c/43/publikime), parse the yearly links to /d/{id}/{year} (or /eng/d/{id}/{year}) detail pages, then extract the direct PDF link (href under /media/*.pdf) and fetch it. No JS, cookies or auth required. Standard curl/requests works.

Static HTTP scrape via curl/requests. Site runs Adobe Experience Manager: report pages list PDFs as /content/dam/rbi/retail/eu/ba/.../<file>.pdf.coredownload.pdf which return application/pdf directly (200, no auth/cookies). For A1 corporate disclosures, scrape the publications.html page for .coredownload.pdf hrefs and fetch each. For A2/A3 tenders, poll the aktuelni-tenderi page (parse HTML for notice titles, publish/deadline dates, procurement contact email). EN and BS (/en/ vs /bs/) mirror versions exist for language coverage.

Plain HTTP GET with curl/requests; follow the www.ubb.bg -> ubb.bg 301 redirect (use -L / allow_redirects). Pages are fully server-side rendered, so scrape HTML directly. For A1/A3 disclosures: fetch /en/about/reports (or /bg/about/reports) and harvest href links matching /attachments/Tab/{id}/download_(en|bg)/*.pdf (197 PDF links present). For A1/A5 news & product intel: paginate /en/news?page=N (~210 pages) or use the year/category filters; each item has a date, category tag and link. For A5 jobs: scrape /en/careers/positions. No API, login, or JS execution needed.

Scrape the subsidiaries-annual-reports HTML page (static, server-rendered) and extract href links matching /content/dam/portalgroup/.../pdf_bilanci_controllate_<yy>/*.pdf, then GET the PDFs directly (no auth, no cookies, no JS). Balkan subsidiaries present: Albania (ISP_Bank_Albania-...pdf), Bosnia (ISP_Banka_Bosna_I_Hercegovina_...pdf, latest 2024), Croatia (Privredna Banka Zagreb ...ENG.pdf). For news (A1/A5), scrape /en/newsroom/all-news and /en/newsroom/press-releases with year filter; article URLs follow /en/newsroom/all-news/news/<year>/<slug>.

Poll the WordPress RSS category feed https://banker.bg/category/finansovi-novini/feed/ (finance section) plus site-wide https://banker.bg/feed/ for new items; each item gives title, link, pubDate. Fetch individual article HTML via a real browser / browser-UA rendering fetcher (WebFetch-style) because plain curl is 403-blocked. Discover the full URL set via the sitemap index https://banker.bg/sitemap_index.xml (needs browser-like fetch). Filter feed items for BORICA/BLINK/BNB/payments/bank names for A1/A3/A6.

Scrape the annual-reports page (both /en/annual-reports and /sr/godisnji-izvjestaji) with a simple HTTP GET + HTML parse; collect all hrefs matching the pattern https://www.novabanka.com/download-godisnji/{numericID}/pdf/{URL-encoded-filename} and fetch each PDF directly (no auth, no cookies, no browser). For press releases (A1/A5/A6), crawl the paginated list at /sr/kategorija-novosti/saopstenja-za-javnost (and /obavjestenja-za-klijente) — ~26 pages, each /sr/novost/{slug} is a static article. Careers at /sr/karijera. All static HTML, reproducible with curl.

Scrape the annual-reports and financial-statements listing pages (both /en/ and /bg/ paths) for /en/files/{id}-*.pdf and /bg/files/... links; download PDFs directly by URL (no auth, no JS). Poll /bg/za-ckb/novini and /en/about-ccb/news for A1 disclosures and /bg/za-ckb/karieri for A5 jobs. File IDs increment (~1374=2020 ... 2367=2024) so new-year reports are predictable.

Site (HTML pages + wp-json REST) is behind Cloudflare 'challenge' and returns 403 to curl/WebFetch, BUT static assets under /wp-content/uploads/ are served directly (tested: annual-report-2010.pdf returned 200 application/pdf with valid %PDF-1.6 content). So: use a browser session to render the Raporte Vjetore / Lajmet e Fundit / Vende Vakante pages and harvest the /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf links, then download those PDFs directly with plain HTTP (no challenge on uploads). WordPress => reports follow /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/ naming.

Scrape the annual-reports and financial-reports listing pages (eng/ and shq/ paths) for /Uploads/Data/Files/*.pdf links and download directly (no auth/JS; PDF confirmed 11.3MB, application/pdf). The financial-reports (raportet-financiare) page 302-redirects to a year subpath — follow redirects and iterate year subpaths. Poll /shq/lajme/ and /shq/njoftime/ for A1/A3 news and product/payments pages for A6.

download.type: XLSX (also PDF interim/annual reports and IR news)

sources.recommended_method: Scrape the financial-reports HTML index (and /investors/news, /news-media/press-releases) for cdn0.erstegroup.com PDF/XLSX links, which follow a predictable per-year path pattern (Investor_Relations/<year>/reports|tab|presentations|news_en/). Download PDFs/XLSX directly; no auth or JS needed.

Scrape the WordPress listing pages (izvjestaji-i-publikacije, novosti, press-kit, tarifnik-i-kamatne-stope, karijera) with plain HTTP GET; harvest /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf links for A1 financial disclosures. Static HTML, no JS needed. Optionally use WordPress REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts for the Novosti feed.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML sections (reports, saopstenja, karijera) with a simple HTTP client (curl/requests, no JS). Reports/disclosures live on Adobe AEM /content/dam/... paths as direct application/pdf links; harvest those hrefs and download PDFs. Poll saopstenja-i-aktuelnosti and karijera pages for A1/A3/A5 items.

api.params: documented in vendor Zendesk help; filters incl. location/donor/sector

download.type: XML sitemap index (tenders_sitemap_1..N.xml); URL enumeration only, not tender content

sources.recommended_method: For structured collection use the official DevelopmentAid External API (https://www.developmentaid.org/api/external) with a purchased membership api-key. Free/anonymous access only yields JS-rendered teaser listings; full tender detail is paywalled. tenders_sitemap.xml can be crawled unauthenticated to discover tender URLs, but detail pages still require login. Requires commercial subscription decision.

Scrape the investor-relations HTML pages (/en/finance, /en/annual-investors-reports, /en/announcements) to harvest the /uploads/finances/<hash>.pdf and .zip links, then GET each file (no auth). For A5 jobs, collect from the external ATS at https://apply.smartcv.co/spacehellas (SmartCV). For news, scrape /el/news and /en/news.

ASP.NET WebForms postback: GET the .aspx page (keep session cookie), scrape __VIEWSTATE/__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR/__EVENTVALIDATION, then POST with __EVENTTARGET=dataPoMjesecima$ctrlN$ctlMM$linkToFile for the desired month. Server returns Content-Disposition attachment filename EOJN_OCD_DD_MM_YYYY.zip (application/octet-stream) holding an OCDS JSON. Tested: Feb-2018 file downloaded (121,974 bytes, valid ZIP). No login required. Iterate targets ctrl0..ctrlN to cover all months 2018-2026.

Download Official Gazette issues directly from the Alfresco WebDAV path (FZ/{year}/{n}/FZ-{year}-{n}.pdf) — no login, supports HTTP range requests (206). Enumerate issue numbers per year sequentially. For consolidated acts, resolve the WebDAV path from the ELI act metadata. The /eli/fz, /eli/bnjz, /eli/akte browse pages are an Angular SPA (JS-rendered) that fetches metadata from a backend API — use browser/headless rendering to discover act paths, then fetch PDFs directly.

Scrape the Cyrillic/Latin section pages (/cyr/aktuelno/javne-nabavke, /obavjestenja, /nova-izdanja) directly over HTTPS with a standard client; harvest PDF links under /uploads/pdfs/slglasnik/. No JS or auth needed. For the full electronic gazette/register of regulations use the online portal online.slglasnik.org/sr/pregled.

Fetch pages and PDFs over HTTPS but MUST send a browser User-Agent header (default/curl/WebFetch UA is blocked with 403). Parse finansijski-izvjestaji.html for links under /content/dam/cee2020-pws-bh2/dokumenti*/*.pdf; same for /o-nama/novosti/objave.html and /karijera. PDFs return content-type application/pdf and download cleanly with browser UA.

Scrape the annual-reports page (and careers/news pages) for /en/documents/[id] links, then HTTP GET each document id to fetch the PDF (Content-Type application/pdf, Content-Disposition filename provided). No JS or auth required. For jobs (A5) crawl https://www.procreditbank.bg/en/careers; for corporate news (A1) crawl /en/about-us/notifications-and-news/news; for supplier/ESG (A6) crawl /en/about-us/esg-sustainability.

Scrape the fees-and-interchange.html page for the ~40 per-country PDF hrefs under /content/dam/VCOM/regional/ve/unitedkingdom/PDF/fees-and-interchange/<period>/, then GET each PDF (no auth). Greece file follows pattern greece-<mon><yy>.pdf. Update the period folder (e.g. april-25) each release cycle. For press releases use a browser session (newsroom listing is JS-rendered).

Poll RSS feeds and parse XML <item> nodes: https://www.bankingnews.gr/rss (all articles), https://www.bankingnews.gr/rss/trapezika-nea (banking news, A4/A6), https://www.bankingnews.gr/rss/deltia-typou (press releases, A2). No auth, no JS. HTML article pages linked from feed for full text.

Scrape the banking category HTML page https://www.jobfind.gr/JobAds/Trapezika-Banking/all/GR/Theseis_Ergasias (server-rendered titles/companies/locations/dates; paginate via ?cnt=N). For broad early-intent monitoring also poll RSS https://www.jobfind.gr/rss/rssjobfind_recentads.ashx (all categories, ttl=60).

Scrape the oikonomika-stoixeia HTML page for <a href=*.pdf> links (paths under /images/ and /images/pdf_upload/), then GET each annual report PDF. Also scrape /el/trapeza/nea-anakoinoseis for announcements (A1) and the PSD2 developer page /el/psifiakes-ypiresies/psd2-developer-programm (A6). Static HTML, no auth.

Scrape /financial-reports/, /investor-relations/ and /news/ for hrefs under /static/uploads/*.pdf and *.xlsx; download consolidated reports (PDF) + Key Financial Data (xlsx) per period. Consistent naming: Addiko-Group-{Earnings-Release|Results-Presentation|Key-Financial-Data}-{PERIOD}.{pdf|xlsx}.

Scrape https://www.dypa.gov.gr/statistika HTML for links under /storage/statistika-stoikheia/*; download the monthly data-table XLSX (pattern pinakes-<month>-<year>.xlsx) and associated PDF reports. Procurement: scrape /promitheies-diaghonismi HTML list (items link to detail pages). No auth. EN mirror under /en/. Employment programmes at /en/active-employment-policies.
Scrape static HTML pages (en_about.html, en_financial.html, en_corporate_governance.html, en_terms.html, en_psd2api.html) and fetch linked PDFs under /assets/pdf/. Plain static site, no auth, no JS.

api.params: standard WP REST (posts, categories; category 87 = publications)

sources.recommended_method: Scrape the annual-reports category page (static HTML, /page/2/ .. /page/4/ for older years) to collect per-year post URLs (e.g. /en/annual-report-2023/), each linking a PDF under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/. Download PDFs directly (confirmed 200/206 application/pdf, range-supported). WordPress REST API and RSS feeds (e.g. .../annual-reports/feed/) also available for structured listing.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML listing at /el/nomologia?page=N (integer pagination, ?page=0..N) and follow the /sites/default/files/Law cases/*.pdf links; no auth, no JS. For pre-contractual audit reports also crawl the έλεγχοι section and node pages (e.g. /el/node/1523) which link report PDFs directly.

Server-rendered HTML — scrape law detail pages at /fbih/Zakon/{id}, /bih/Zakon/{id}, /rs/Zakon/{id} for title, institution, posted date, deadline/status; download draft-law PDFs from the javnarasprava.blob.core.windows.net Azure blob 'Preuzmite tekst zakona' links. Crawl homepage/entity listings to enumerate active consultations. No login/JS needed.

Use sitemap index https://www.scalefocus.com/sitemaps.xml to enumerate URLs from case-studies-sitemap1.xml (A6/A2 finance case studies) and positions-sitemap1.xml (A5 jobs), then scrape each HTML page. WP REST default /wp/v2/posts route is disabled (404 rest_no_route), so use sitemaps rather than the API. Filter case studies by industry=Banking/Financial Services on the /case-studies/ listing.

Download the annual XLSX/PDF from the publications page. Direct PDF returns HTTP 200 application/pdf (content-length ~3.88 MB). Scrape the /our-publications/startups-in-greece/ page each December for the new year's PDF link (WordPress /wp-content/uploads/ path).

Scrape the financial-statements HTML page for /sites/default/files/inline-files/*.pdf links and GET each annual report PDF (no auth). Poll the Career Opportunities page (HTML) for A5 job signals. Filenames are not fully predictable across years, so parse the page rather than guessing URLs.

Direct HTTP GET of the .xlsx files under /web/files/documents/... (tested: HTTP 200, content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 11.4KB). Scrape /bg/za-fgvb/statistika for current file links; scrape /bg/za-vlojitelite/banki for the member-bank list. No login required.

Scrape statistics HTML pages under /hr|/en/... for links to UserDocsImages/*.xlsx (and .pdf) and download the linked Excel files directly via HTTP GET. Excel download confirmed (HTTP 206, valid application/vnd.openxmlformats spreadsheet). For fiskalizacija B2C regulatory content, monitor the /hr/fiskalizacija... HTML pages for text/deadlines.

Pull /feed/ (application/rss+xml, HTTP 200) for latest articles; for Bulgaria/payments use the WordPress search feed https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/?s=Bulgaria+payments&feed=rss2 . Avoid scraping the HTML homepage which returns 403 to non-browser clients.

Scrape the Sluzbeni glasnici listing (WordPress, server-rendered) to harvest direct wp-content PDF links per year/issue; separately scrape /gradska-uprava/javne-nabavke/ and /gradska-uprava/budzet-grada/ for A2 procurement and budget data. No login.
GET RSS feed https://news.sap.com/greece/feed/ (application/rss+xml, no auth); poll periodically and parse item titles/links/dates
GET RSS feed https://biztech.gr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, no auth); parse items. Per-category feeds available via /category/<slug>/feed/

GET the .csv sibling of the .html page, no auth. Tested: HTTP 200, text/csv, 57KB, header row EUROPEAN CODE,LEI,NAME,ADDRESS,OPERATOR,PROVIDER,SMALL PSP,GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE,DEROGATION,TYPE OF LICENCE. Data timestamped (2026/07/16) so poll periodically.

sources.recommended_method: GET RSS https://www.itsecuritypro.gr/feed/ (tested: HTTP 200, application/rss+xml) or WordPress REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=&page= for full listings; no auth
GET the category RSS feed with a browser User-Agent (application/rss+xml, 200). Parse <item> titles/pubDate/link, then fetch each post HTML for tender PDFs. Cloudflare blocks generic UAs.
GET per-ticker RSS feed /rss/news/DBD/ (application/rss+xml, 200, no auth). Parse <item> titles/links for vendor PR. Swap ticker for other vendors (e.g. Diebold Nixdorf = DBD).

Prefer WP REST API GET /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&page=N (JSON, paginated) if enabled; otherwise crawl XML sitemap index (post-sitemap.xml..post-sitemap5.xml, lastmod dated) then scrape article HTML. Site is WordPress.
Poll the WordPress RSS feed https://prapaskena.com/feed/ (application/rss+xml, validated) with a browser User-Agent; category feeds available as /category/<slug>/feed/.

Poll site-wide RSS https://telegraf.al/feed/ (validated 200 text/xml) and filter for ekonomi items, OR HTML-scrape https://telegraf.al/category/ekonomi/. Category feed /category/ekonomi/feed/ is disabled (WP 500 'No feed available').

Use RSS https://dev.events/rss.xml (validated) or HTML-scrape the location page /EU/AL/Tirana/tech; per-event iCal available. Note the Tirana page mixes local + globally/online-accessible events, so location-filter on parse.

Scrape the sluzbene-novine-tk index page for /Dokumenti/sl_novine/{year}/*.pdf links (predictable path pattern Sluzbene_novine_TK_BR_{n}-{year}.pdf) and download issues; parse for procurement/legal notices.

Download full CORDIS project+organisation datasets from data.europa.eu (Horizon Europe / H2020 / FP7), filter organisations by country=HR and payments/fintech/banking keywords. Bulk files are the reliable source rather than scraping the JS search UI.

Crawl HTML listings at www.dkom.hr/odluke/10 (Javna objava odluka) and the Upisnik search (www.dkom.hr/upisnik/9, filter by year/type), then follow the pdf.dkom.hr/dokumentit/<timestamp>.pdf links. Individual PDFs are directly downloadable (tested: 200, application/pdf, 549KB).
Scrape the /rezultate-dhe-publikime/ page for /media/<id>/*.pdf links and download annual reports directly. Predictable /media/ path; new reports appear yearly.

Scrape HTML listing pages: Greece press releases (https://www.deloitte.com/gr/en/about/press-room/press-releases.html) and industry/insights hubs (banking-capital-markets, financial-services, tax alerts). Headlines/links are server-rendered in the HTML, so a plain GET + HTML parse works, no browser session or auth needed. For research reports (Digital Banking Maturity, Regulatory Outlook) follow article pages to linked PDFs and download individually as needed.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML announcement table at https://athens.euronext.com/en/market-data/announcements, paginating with ?page=N (page=0..N); each row links to /en/more-options/announcements/announcement-<id>. Use a browser-like User-Agent (curl works; the old www.athexgroup.gr host 403s bots on legacy paths but the euronext host serves fine). For a specific issuer use /en/market-data/issuers/<id>/announcements (e.g. 278=Alpha Bank) — note that page's announcement list is loaded by a separate Drupal view AJAX block ('announcements-displays-final'), so per-issuer needs either the aggregated page filtered by issuer or a browser session; the aggregated page is the simplest collection target. Greek versions via /el/ prefix.

Scrape HTML insight/industry pages. Poll the regulatory-insights hub (https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/regulatory-insights.html) and the annual '20xx Financial Services Regulatory Priorities' articles for A3; scrape Greece People Services pages (executive-search-selection.html, compensation-benefits-surveys.html) and industries/banking.html for A2/A5. Follow /home/ -> non-/home/ 301 redirects. Some barometer/radar reports link to PDFs behind marketing/registration forms — flag those individually.

Scrape paginated HTML: GET https://www.temenos.com/press-releases/page/N/ (N=1..54, path-based pagination returns server-rendered HTML, no JS/auth needed). Filter deal/partner/go-live announcements; parse date-stamped entries. Same pattern applies to https://www.temenos.com/success-stories/ for customer case studies.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML of the hub pages (BCM industry page, /en_gr/technical/tax/tax-alerts, and en_gl EMEIA insight URLs) and follow article links; content is present in HTML (AEM), no auth/JS needed. Use a browser-like User-Agent.

Scrape investors.dieboldnixdorf.com/news-and-events/press-releases (IR platform, year-indexed URLs .../press-releases/news-details/2026/...) or news.dieboldnixdorf.com/press-releases. IR sites usually expose an RSS feed - check for one.

Two-tier: (1) For structured time-series data use the PX-Web databank on port 8083 (databaza.instat.gov.al:8083/pxweb/en/DST/). It is classic ASP.NET PX-Web; the JSON REST API (/api/v1/) is disabled, so table data must be exported via the PX-Web query UI (px/csv/xlsx) driven by a browser/form-POST session - best done with a headless browser. (2) For releases, narrative, methodology and deadlines, scrape static HTML at www.instat.gov.al thematic pages, /en/publications/press-releases and /en/publications/calendar/ (all plain HTML, curl-friendly). Use both /en/ and /sq/ language prefixes.

Scrape the HTML project register at https://www.eib.org/en/projects/loans/index.htm?countries=GR (signed loans) and https://www.eib.org/en/projects/all/ (paginated); also monitor procurement page https://www.eib.org/en/about/procurement/index. No public CSV/JSON export; data.europa.eu EIB dataset distributions merely link back to these HTML pages. All three sample URLs return HTTP 200.

Static HTTP GET scraping. Fetch https://www.payten.com/en/news-events/news/ (nginx, 200, text/html, fully server-rendered — no browser/JS required). Parse article links matching the pattern /en/news-events/news/{slug}/ and follow pagination via ?page=N (?page=2 returns 200). Each article page is plain HTML with title, date and body. Poll periodically for A6 competitor/vendor intelligence. For product/offer pages (e.g. /en/offers/for-merchants/payment-acceptance/, /en/offers/for-payment-financial-institutions/atm-related-services/moneyget-atm-network/) fetch directly, also static HTML.

HTTP GET on server-rendered pages: /press (EN newsroom) and /hr-HR/novosti (Croatian news/blog), paginate via ?p=N (e.g. /press?p=1). Also /hr-HR/regulatory-info (A3 regulation) and /about (A1). Content is present in raw HTML, so plain curl/HTTP fetch works without a browser. For job openings (A5), the /careers page renders the list via a Talentlyft JS widget (talentlyftWidget) rather than server HTML, so use the Talentlyft feed/widget or a headless browser for jobs specifically.

Static HTML scraping. Crawl section landing pages (news /bs/novosti/kratke-vijesti and /bs/novosti/bhbankar, events /bs/dogadjaji, jobs /bs/novosti/zaposljavanje, tag pages e.g. /bs/novosti/tag/platni_promet, member banks /bs/banke-clanice, documents /bs/dokumenti/prezentacije) then follow item detail links. English mirror under /en. Pages are server-rendered, so plain HTTP GET + HTML parser (BeautifulSoup/Cheerio) works; no JS execution or login needed. robots.txt allows all crawling. Downloadable files (PDF/PPT White Books, presentations) live on document detail pages - follow through to capture direct file links.

Scrape the server-rendered list at https://www.strategy.bg/bg/public-consultations with GET query params: fieldOfAction=21 (Financial policy), plus optional actType, institution, administrative-level filters, and page=N pagination (?page=1..~500). Each row links to a detail page https://www.strategy.bg/bg/public-consultations/{id} (e.g. /12514) carrying title, dates, institution and attached document links. For low-latency change detection, poll the Atom feed https://www.strategy.bg/public-consultation.rss (Content-Type application/xml). No login/JS/cookies beyond a harmless session cookie are required; plain HTTP GET reproduces everything outside a browser.

Scrape HTML at https://ingenico.com/en/newsroom/press-releases and /en/newsroom/blogs; follow ?page=N pagination ('Show me more' link). Item links follow /en/newsroom/press-releases/<slug>. No auth, no RSS observed.

Poll RSS feeds on a schedule with a plain HTTP GET (no JS, no auth). Use https://www.bug.hr/rss for all posts, https://www.bug.hr/rss/biznis for business/IT, and https://www.bug.hr/rss/fintech for fintech/payments/crypto/regulation. Feeds are RSS 2.0 with <title>, <link>, <category>, <description>, <pubDate>. Pattern is https://www.bug.hr/rss/<section-or-tag>. For deeper article text, follow each item <link> and scrape the static HTML. ttl=30 min, so poll ~30-60 min.

sources.recommended_method: Scrape the paginated public notice listings (njoftimi-i-fituesit, njoftimi-i-kontrates-se-shpallur, njoftime by year) — each server-rendered HTML page (~10 records; 3600+ pages) lists tenders with document links via /GetData/DownloadDocument?documentId=...&docType=.... No login needed for public notices. For clean structured A1/A2 data prefer Open Procurement Albania (openprocurement.al) which exports each tender passport as JSON/Excel. The e-prokurim/SPE transactional platform itself requires operator login for bidding but public outcomes are published on app.gov.al.

Scrape HTML list at https://www.epant.gr/apofaseis-gnomodotiseis.html (EL) or /en/decisions.html (EN), paginating with ?start=N (increments of ~23; 45 pages EL / 16 EN). Follow item links to /apofaseis-gnomodotiseis/item/<id>-*.html to get full decision text and PDF links. Can also filter by year-tag URLs or company tags (e.g. Piraeus Bank). Scrape static HTML listing https://usa.visa.com/about-visa/newsroom/press-releases-listing.html (headlines+links present in server HTML, no JS needed); follow /about-visa/newsroom/press-releases.releaseId.<ID>.html for full text. No RSS/API exposed.

download.type: PDF (annual/sustainability & business reports linked from the annual-reports page)

sources.recommended_method: Use the migrated domain piraeusgroup.gr. Scrape HTML of /en/press-office/news-announcements/ for announcements and /en/investor-relations/annual-reports for annual report PDF links (follow through to per-year PDF URLs). No auth.

Scrape the press-release listing at https://usa.visa.com/about-visa/newsroom/press-releases-listing.html (individual releases at /press-releases.releaseId.NNNNN.html) and/or corporate.visa.com newsroom; filter for Greece/payments keywords.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML list at /news/<vendor>/ with pagination; or subscribe to PR Newswire RSS feeds (linked in footer /rss/). Behind Cloudflare but no active bot challenge observed on curl/WebFetch — use a realistic User-Agent.

Scrape HTML with a browser User-Agent (curl -A works, returns 200; note WebFetch gets 403 from Cloudflare). Procurement opportunities are listed at /work-with-us/procurement/catalogue; the Greece SME page is /supporting-smes/eif-near-me/greece. Download procurement-guide-2025.pdf for guidance.

api.params: n/a

sources.recommended_method: git clone or download the repos; use them as clients: run the Diavgeia OpenData API sample against opendata.diavgeia.gov.gr, and use OP-TED eForms SDK/TED API docs to pull EU tender notices. GitHub content itself via git or api.github.com, no auth needed.

GET-scrape the HTML with a normal browser User-Agent (Akamai blocks generic bot UAs -> WebFetch got 403, but plain curl returns 200). Parse the ~23 <a href='/gr/en/publications/financial-services/*.html'> links; individual reports often link to PDFs. Same approach for /gr/en/newsletters/legal-news.html.
Browser-session or WebFetch scrape of finacle.com/news-room/ and infosys.com/newsroom/press-releases.html; direct curl is Akamai bot-blocked (403). Use realistic User-Agent/headless browser.
Ignore hugedomains.com (domain reseller, not a source). Scrape oktopayments.com (news/about/products) for A6 vendor/competitor intel on OKTO.

Scrape the news-press HTML page (server-rendered CMS); iterate the year filter (2005–2026) to enumerate items and follow each 'MORE' link to the full article. No auth/JS needed. Also harvest footer PDFs for fees/agreements. Greek version likely at /news-press/ without /en/.

Pull the Greece-category RSS feed https://www.electronicpaymentsinternational.com/region/europe/greece/feed/ (200, application/rss+xml). Site-wide feed also at /feed/. Fall back to scraping the HTML region page for older archive items.
Scrape HTML tender lists from www2.dgmarket.com with a browser User-Agent (Greece country filter). Avoid the legacy www.dgmarket.com/tenders/list.do path which returns 403 (Cloudflare).

Scrape the HTML news listing at https://www.sepe.gr/nea/ (12 items per page, ~1723 total). Older items load via a 'ΔΕΙΤΕ ΠΕΡΙΣΣΟΤΕΡΑ' (See more) AJAX button; first-page HTML is directly scrapable. Sidebar year/month filters give archive navigation.

Scrape the paginated tenders listing at https://www.e-efka.gov.gr/el/diagonismoi (886 items, ~89 pages, date-range filter available); follow each item link to its detail page for attached tender documents/PDFs. Also cover /el/ilektronikes-ypiresies for e-services.

Server-side GET to /searchJob/index.php with sector filter and large _pagerRows; parse the HTML job cards (title, employer, location, date). Fully reproducible outside a browser (200, no cookies). Note charset is windows-1251. Verify/adjust sector IDs to the banking/finance codes (the sample 112,113,116,117 map to IT/energy/industry sectors, not banking).

Retire the mercury-processing.com source (domain no longer serves content). Collect from Nexi Group site (nexigroup.com newsroom/press, investor relations) and Nexi Croatia (nexi.hr) for careers/clients; these are the live successor sources for the Croatian card-processing entity.

HTTP GET + HTML parse of pretraga.htm search-results pages (server-rendered Bootstrap/jQuery, no JS needed). Note: full tender detail/monitoring is a paid subscription service; for free/official BiH procurement use ejn.gov.ba or javnenabavke.gov.ba as complement.

Periodic HTTP GET + HTML parse of the /portal/en/tenders/ (or /bs/ which 301s to /en/) section; individual tender announcements are server-rendered pages, PDFs linked per-item. Also /portal/en/taxpayer-database/ for A1/A6.

HTTP GET + HTML parse of homepage (Novosti feed replaces old aktuelno.php) plus /Content/Read/zakoni for laws and the Javni pozivi/obavijesti section for bank-selection public calls; documents linked as PDFs. IIS/.NET routes use GET only (HEAD returns 405).

HTTP GET + HTML parse of stories.html (case studies), news.html and insights.html for banking/fintech client wins; industries/fintech.html and services pages for solution/competitor intel. Server-rendered, no JS/API.

Scrape the server-rendered tender list pages (zatvoreni-s145 closed, otvoreni-s144 open) with HTTP GET; parse ~100+ entries with title, start/end dates and PDF links under /storage/upload/natjecaji/. No pagination, single list.

For A2: scrape javne-nabavke archive (single-list PDFs). For A3/A5: scrape Novosti. For statistics: use companion domain irbrs.net databases, esp. Economic Indicators at https://www.irbrs.net/statistika/Default.aspx (ASP.NET WebForms) and Placed Credits DB https://www.irbrs.net/PlasiraniKreditiBaza/. All server-rendered HTTP GET.

Static HTML site: scrape the relevant topic pages (javne-nabavke-BiH.html for A2 procurement law/case-law, bankarsko-pravo.html for A3 banking law, legislation-bosnia.html for consolidated legislation index) and follow linked PDF laws/decisions. Simple HTTP GET, no JS.

Periodically scrape /karijere/ for A5 job openings (currently none listed) and product pages (/proizvodi/online-placanja/) for A1/A2 product/vendor intel; check for a WordPress /feed/ if a news/blog section is added.

Static HTML scrape of the WordPress site. Careers listings under /category/careers/ (WP category feed likely available at /category/careers/feed/), vendor/product pages under /card-management-software/ etc. Optionally use WP REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) if enabled.

GET the legacy case viewer https://www.aop.bg/case2.php?doc_id=<ID>&mode=show_doc&newver=2 for archived pre-2020 procurement notices; use search UI at www2.aop.bg to enumerate cases. Server is SLOW — use generous timeouts (25s+) and retries. NOTE: live procurement has moved to the successor CAIS EOP portal at app.eop.bg (eop.bg) — use that for current tenders.

sources.recommended_method: Do not scrape TenderWolf (login-gated commercial SaaS). Collect the same BG/HR tender data directly from the official TED public API (POST search with CPV/country filters, JSON) or national portals (BG: app.eop.bg / Croatia: eojn.nn.hr).
Static HTML scraping of category listing pages (/dogadjanja for events, /tvrtke-trzista, /poslovi) and article pages. No API/RSS documented; standard GET requests work (Apache, 200 OK).

download.type: PDF (PSD2 reporting statistics, monthly, incl. Jan-May 2026)

sources.recommended_method: Preferred: Careerjet Public Search API at public.api.careerjet.net/search with locale_code=bs_BA plus a free affid, returning structured JSON (title, company, locations, url, date, salary). Fallback: scrape the HTML search results and paginate via ?p=N (verified ?p=2 returns 200). Filter by region via /posao/<Region> paths (Kanton-Sarajevo, Republika-Srpska, Bosna-i-Hercegovina).

Scrape the homepage and business pages (e.g. /poslovni-korisnici/keks-pay-za-webshop/) for product/merchant/market signals and headline user counts. There is no press/news/investor/API section on this domain — for corporate disclosures, tenders and payment-market statistics (A1/A2/A4), use Erste&Steiermarkische Bank Croatia's corporate/press site and the Croatian National Bank (HNB) payments statistics.

Scrape the /about-us/news HTML listing with pagination (numbered pages 1-10+), plus /solutions/* product pages. Static server-rendered HTML (IIS), no JS needed. No RSS feed exists (feed/, rss, news/feed all 404).

Scrape static HTML pages (Cloudflare-fronted, PHP). Root ak-invest.com 301-redirects to www.ak-invest.com; use www. Target the Careers page (under company info) for A5/early-intent and About/governance for A1. No API detected.

Scrape article HTML from category listing pages (e.g. /en/category/economy/, /en/category/analysis/) with pagination; server-rendered so plain HTTP GET works. WordPress REST API (wp-json) and RSS (/feed/) are disabled (404), so use HTML scraping.

Scrape server-rendered HTML pages (Procurement-Regulations, Local-presence/Europe, Transparency) via HTTP GET (200 OK). KfW does NOT list actual tender/consulting notices on this domain — they are published on GTAI (www.gtai.de) and the KfW e-tendering platform; project/transparency data is exposed as a JS microsite at www.kfw.de/microsites/Microsite/transparenz.kfw.de and as IATI/BMZ open project data at bmz.de. Use those for structured tender/project data.

Poll RSS feed https://www.balkanweb.com/feed/ (200, application/rss+xml) for new articles; scrape full article HTML for economy/tech/fintech items. WordPress site, so /wp-json/wp/v2/posts REST API likely also available if richer querying needed.
Static HTML scraping of homepage and country/press/about pages; no structured data feed. Use for A6 vendor/competitor profiling (ATM footprint) and A2 signals.

HTTP GET + HTML scrape of /Poduzece/Pregled/{slug}/Detaljno/{id} profile pages for basic registry data (name, OIB, MB, uprava/management, ownership, NKD activities). Full financial statements and 'Povezani subjekti' require account registration/subscription (freemium ~28 EUR+PDV per company) - treat those as paywalled.

Primary: pull https://www.posao.hr/rss/ (valid RSS 2.0 XML) for fresh postings. Secondary: HTTP GET + HTML scrape of keyword search pages (e.g. /trazeni-izraz/banka/) and employer profile pages (/profil/{slug}/{id}/). Listings render server-side in HTML; behind Cloudflare but plain curl with a browser UA returns 200 - no JS needed.

Scrape static HTML on the corrected /pagamenti-tips/ page and the /media/notizia/ news items (e.g. TIPS Clone Western Balkans). Add ?com.dotmarketing.htmlpage.language=1 for English. Follow linked PDFs for detail.

Plain HTTP scraping. The Upisnik page (/upisnik/9) is server-rendered HTML with <table> data and <select> filters (year/type/category); the decisions page (/javna-objava-odluka/10) lists dated decisions with PDF links. No JS or API needed — parse HTML tables and follow PDF links.
Poll RSS https://forbes.dnevnik.hr/feed/ for A2/A5 signals; supplement with section HTML /rubrika/financije/ and /rubrika/tech/ (paginated). Cloudflare-fronted but curl/WebFetch succeed without JS.

Scrape DEI pages (server-rendered Apache, EN + BS) for IPA III/WBIF programming documents, action fiches and regulation PDFs (A2 tenders/A3 regulation/A4 funding). Cross-reference EC enlargement portal for canonical IPA docs.

Scrape static HTML pages: /hr/platforma and /eng/about-us (references, client list ~13 banks in SI/HR, case studies). Small vendor site - low update frequency; periodic scrape of platform + news/references pages suffices.
Scrape the static HTML at /past-winners/ (single page, all years server-rendered). Homepage lists current-year categories for A6/A2 competitor intel.
GET RSS feed https://selfservice.gr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, no auth). For the executive-moves tag, use its tag RSS by appending /feed/ to the tag URL, or scrape the tag HTML page.

hradf.com is frozen ('η ιστοσελίδα του ΤΑΙΠΕΔ δεν ενημερώνεται πλέον'). Use successor Growthfund: scrape https://growthfund.gr/en/procurement/ (EN) or https://growthfund.gr/prokirykseis/ (EL) for tenders, plus https://ppf.growthfund.gr/en/calls-for-tenders-procurements/ for strategic-contract tenders. Individual tenders link to PDFs.

sources.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered HTML list (each notice: code, dates, deadline, budget, linked PDFs). Follow pagination 'Σελ. 1 από 5' (~5 pages); also collect the parent /TheCompany/Contests/ hub which links Works notices too. Download tender PDFs per notice.
Scrape the static past-winners HTML (winners embedded in markup, no JS, no JSON-LD). Parse by year and award category. No auth.

Scrape INEMY Έρευνες listing at https://inemy.gr/ekdoseis/erevnes/ and download report PDFs (hosted on inemy.gr/wp-content/uploads/ and Mailchimp mcusercontent.com). Cross-post announcements appear on esee.gr. No auth, server-rendered HTML.

Scrape the 'Joint Procurements / Procurement & Contract Opportunities' page for active joint tenders and lead-central-bank info; download conference PDFs. Actual tender notices are published on lead central banks' portals and TED, not hosted here.

Scrape https://www.unisys.com/search/?assets=News+Releases (add keyword e.g. 'Alpha Bank'/'Greece' to filter) and follow individual press-release pages. Corporate PR is also mirrored on the Unisys investor/PR wire (globenewswire) if HTML scrape is insufficient.

GET the category RSS feed https://www.1dype.gov.gr/category/%CE%B4%CE%B9%CE%B1%CE%B3%CF%89%CE%BD%CE%B9%CF%83%CE%BC%CE%BF%CE%AF/feed/ (application/rss+xml, no auth); tender items include ΠΡΟΣΚΛΗΣΗ ΕΝΔΙΑΦΕΡΟΝΤΟΣ notices. Fallback: scrape category HTML page.
Scrape HTML blog listing https://www.epirusbank.com/en/blog (or /blog for Greek); custom CMS (Wapp), server-rendered, dated entries. No RSS/API detected.

Scrape HTML media-center page https://www.bankofthessaly.gr/media-center/ or poll site RSS https://www.bankofthessaly.gr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, tested valid). WordPress; a category-scoped feed may exist for press releases.

Scrape HTML tag archive https://www.fortunegreece.com/tag/fintech/ (paginated /page/N/); for broad coverage poll site RSS https://www.fortunegreece.com/feed/ (valid RSS). WP REST API and tag-specific /feed/ are disabled/empty.
Scrape HTML banks category https://www.liberal.gr/katigories/trapezes (note /trapezes redirects to /katigories/trapezes). Not WordPress; no RSS/REST found; sitemap.xml returns 403.

Pull RSS from https://workenter.gr/feed (application/rss+xml, HTTP 200) for latest recruitment items; or scrape the /category/dimosio-asep HTML listing with numbered pagination for full ASEP/public-sector hiring news. No auth/JS.

Scrape the WordPress category listing https://www.deyah.gr/category/diagonismoi-prokiruxeis/ (paginate /page/N/; WP REST API likely at /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?categories=... also usable). For authoritative tender/contract data cross-reference Diavgeia and promitheus.
Scrape HTML announcement list at /en/announcements and /el/announcements; follow linked PDF documents. Static server-rendered HTML (curl 200), no JS needed.

Scrape static HTML news list at /en/latest-news/ (server-rendered anchors); follow individual /en/latest-news/<slug>/ article pages. Filter by category (Press Release/Financial Reports/Blog/Tech) and year. No RSS.

Scrape static HTML media room list at /about-us/media-room and client stories at /insights/fis-client-stories; follow /about-us/media-room/press-release/<year>/<slug> pages. Consider investor.fisglobal.com for regulated/financial disclosures. No RSS found.

Scrape Proclamations HTML list at /el/Pages/Proclamations.aspx (server-rendered, ASP.NET); the page advertises an RSS feed — subscribe to it for new calls. Homepage / redirects to /el (root 302 chain resolves fine).

Scrape HTML list at /media-insights/; server-rendered article summaries link to full articles. 'Load More' likely triggers an XHR — capture it via browser for full pagination, else follow category/article links. No RSS.
Scrape HTML announcement/press pages (dated URL slugs like /2025/12/09/...). WP REST is blocked by the Disable-REST-API plugin, so use the sitemap or category listing pages and parse article HTML.

GET RSS https://www.ictplus.gr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, no auth) for latest articles; category feeds available at /category/<slug>/feed/. WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) likely also available for pagination/history.
Scrape HTML listing at /news (and /blog); individual posts at /blog/<slug>. Pagination via ?page= (returns 200). No RSS (/feed = 404).

Poll RSS https://www.dimosioidiagonismoi.gr/feed/ (200, valid RSS XML, tested) for new tender/procurement articles; scrape /prodikastiki-prosphigi/ HTML page for remedies content. Optionally /wp-json/wp/v2/posts for JSON. No auth.

Scrape HTML list at /en/business/active-tenders for current tender titles/links; note actual bid submission runs on a separate login-only e-procurement platform, but the public tender list is browsable HTML.

Poll RSS feed https://www.thpa.gr/category/news-en-gb/tenders-procurement/feed/ (application/rss+xml, tested 200) for new tenders; fall back to scraping the paginated HTML category page. Greek equivalent category also available.

Scrape the HTML listing at https://grnet.gr/category/rfps/ (WordPress; try /category/rfps/page/N/ for pagination, or the WP REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?categories=<rfps id> if enabled). Greek-only content.

GET-scrape https://www.mindigital.gr/prokhryxeis (WordPress; use a normal browser User-Agent — HEAD requests hit an Akamai 503 but GET returns 200). Consider /wp-json/wp/v2/ if enabled. Related formal decisions are also on Diavgeia.

Scrape HTML at https://www.quest.gr/en/news-by-company?cid=Uni+Systems and paginate with &page=N (server-side). Swap cid for other subsidiaries (e.g. cid=Uni Systems). Follow article READ MORE links for full text.

sources.recommended_method: Scrape/download free Coface economic publications and the Business Risk Dashboard (Greece country + sector risk) as PDFs. GEMI-sourced company credit reports require CofaNet/Business Information login (manual).

Scrape the press room HTML: newsroom https://www.mynewsdesk.com/gr/visa and news archive /gr/visa/latest_news (paginated). Cloudflare-fronted but returns 200 to curl. RSS not exposed at tested paths (rss/all, rss, latest_news.rss all 404).
Poll WordPress RSS at /feed/ (also supports category feeds /category/<slug>/feed/ and ?s= search). Parse for payments/fintech/vendor-deal keywords. Full-content available via content:encoded in RSS.

Use RSS at /rss/ (or /rss) for latest 15 items site-wide; for topical depth scrape the business category HTML /biznes-cat3.html with pagination (2900+ pages). RSS is general (not business-only), so combine with category HTML scraping for A2/A5 signals.

Redirect target: scrape avenga.com (industries: Banking & Financial Services; case studies) for A2 references, and career.avenga.com for jobs/early-intent. musala.com/* 301-redirects site-wide to avenga.com.

Scrape hrvatska.posta.hr/hr/javna-nabava for the Registar ugovora and tender listings; individual tender/contract docs are PDFs under /UserDocsImages/. For legally-binding tender data also cross-reference EOJN (Elektronicki oglasnik javne nabave).
Scrape blog list at https://www.wspay.info/cl/131/blog and product pages; no RSS (/feed 404). Server-rendered HTML, no JS/login needed.

download.type: PDF (procedure guideline documents linked from each procedure)

Each procedure page links guideline/methodology PDFs and deadlines (A2/A3). Homepage curl returns 200 with server-rendered HTML despite long WebSphere !ut/p/z1 portal URLs.
Scrape the finansijski-izvjestaji page for the yearly PDF links (annual/interim/auditor reports) and download directly; Apache static hosting, no JS or auth.

Scrape /poslovi with ?page=N pagination (page 2 verified 200) for A2/A4/A5 hiring & vendor signals; also crawl /vijesti for company news/directory. Static HTML, no JS or auth; Cloudflare present but GET works.
Scrape the News/Publications listing pages (WordPress on Cloudflare, static HTML, HTTP 200) periodically for new calls-for-tender and grant announcements. WebFetch or curl both work.

Scrape portal pages (Apache, static HTML, HTTP 200). The e-services hub links to e-Albania for authenticated actual filing/payment. For registry lookups (taxpayer/passive-subject) the actual query tools sit on linked subpages / e-Albania and require the government portal login — mark those specific tools for manual validation.
Static HTTP GET of the id-based CMS pages (index.php?id=XX&jezik=bs); reports are linked as PDFs within the Izvjestaji page. Scrape page then follow PDF links.
Scrape edition landing pages (speakers/agenda/partners) as HTML; rebuild the /YYYY/sofia/ path per festival edition. Watch for new-edition URL each year.

HTTP scrape the WordPress portfolio/news pages (server-rendered HTML with schema.org JSON-LD). Use curl with -k or a client that tolerates an incomplete TLS chain (LiteSpeed server serves an incomplete cert chain). Optionally query WP REST at /wp-json/wp/v2/ for structured posts.
Static HTML scrape of program/news pages plus linked PDF documents; poll the news/decisions listing for A2 (grant programmes under NPVU/ПКИП) and monitor for A5 signals.
Static HTML scrape of program/speakers/sponsors pages for A4/A6 signals (who exhibits/sponsors in the CE payments space) and A2 (event-linked opportunities); re-crawl per edition.
Static HTML scrape of the /koncentracije/ register and the /odluke/ decisions section, following through to per-case PDF decision documents; poll for new merger decisions (A2/A3).

HTTP GET homepage and /termat-dhe-kushtet/ (both 200, static WordPress-style HTML). Scrape terms pages for regulatory/product detail; for licensing status cross-reference Bank of Albania e-money institution register (AK-Invest sh.a.). Low update frequency expected.

Use AIS's data portals rather than the org hub: spending.data.al (Open Spending Albania — procurement & treasury transactions of 1600+ budget institutions, A2/A4) returns 200; open.data.al currently redirects to ndiqparate.al so use the AIS landing at ais.al/new/en/open-data-albania/. Also cross-link the national DCAT-AP portal opendata.gov.al (200) which supports CSV/XML downloads and SPARQL. Inspect each portal for per-dataset export/API endpoints.

Poll the WordPress RSS feed https://www.montran.com/feed/ for new posts; also scrape /resources/ and /client-success/ index pages (static HTML, curl-accessible) to catch vendor/competitor and TIPS/RTGS implementation news relevant to Bulgaria (BORICA).

Poll WordPress RSS: site-wide https://fintech.bg/feed/ and category feed https://fintech.bg/category/банкови-технологии/feed/ (WordPress appends /feed/ to any category). Static HTML, curl-accessible; no JS needed.

Poll WordPress RSS https://paymentsindustryintelligence.com/feed/ for new items; for Bulgaria backfill use the search URL https://paymentsindustryintelligence.com/?s=Bulgaria (static HTML, curl-accessible) and filter. A WordPress search feed is also available via ?s=Bulgaria&feed=rss2.
Scrape individual /event/* pages for agenda, speaker list and sponsor tiers (banks/fintechs = early-intent signals). Monitor the events listing/archive for new conference announcements.

Scrape the paginated press list (server-rendered, curl 200). No RSS observed; iterate pagination (?page=N or /press/N) to collect release titles/dates/links. Filter for Albania/Croatia/OTP Group keywords.
Scrape News and Careers sections for A1/A2 early-intent signals. Likely Webflow-hosted; core content is server-rendered (curl 200). Both www and apex resolve (apex 301->www).
Poll RSS feed https://n1info.hr/feed/ (HTTP 200) and scrape /biznis/ listing for banking/ATM/business coverage (A1/A2).
Static HTML scraping of service/news pages; low-frequency change so periodic full-site crawl is sufficient (A2/A4 vendor/market intel).
Static HTML scraping of the specific procurement/postal-services pages; for structured national tenders cross-reference EOJN (eojn.nn.hr) rather than this CMS. Suitable for A2/A4 targeted monitoring.
HTML scrape /nnsl and /sudske-odluke (with courts[] query filter). For primary regulatory/gazette data prefer official Narodne novine (narodne-novine.nn.hr) which offers structured search.

Static corporate site (HTTP 200) for a private security company. No news, tenders, or structured data, and no evident cash-in-transit/ATM/banking angle. Low intelligence value; deprioritize. If tracked at all, occasional HTML scrape of homepage.

Scrape category HTML listings (e.g. /kategorija/vijesti-iz-hrvatske/, /kategorija/edukacija/). Standard /feed/ RSS redirects back to the HTML homepage, so use category-page scraping rather than RSS.

HTML monitoring of product/news pages as a market-participant (non-bank lender/competitor) signal; no structured data export exists.

HTML scrape of the /investigim listing (no RSS feed available — /feed/ redirects to home) to capture investigative articles touching banking/finance.

Scrape the Croatia country page for headline stats and instrument list; for downloadable factsheets/reports use the fi-compass Library (filter by country=Croatia) which hosts PDF publications.

Collect via a headless/real browser that solves the Cloudflare JS bot challenge (curl and WebFetch both return HTTP 403).
